title: The Pink and Coral Espresso Coffee Corner
description: A pink and coral espresso corner, all from Walmart: a matte black De'Longhi Stilosa espresso machine, The Pioneer Woman Ainsley coral mugs, a Paris Hilton pink canister set, a Martha Stewart milk frother and a Paris Hilton That's Hot glass mug.
intro: Every December I tell myself I'll stop buying lattes on the way home. Then it's 7 am, it's cold, and the drive-thru line is wrapped around the building. So this look fixes the actual problem: a little espresso corner on the counter that's cute enough you want to use it. A matte black machine, coral mugs with stripes, pink canisters with gold script, a frother for the foam and one glass mug that just says That's Hot. It's a coffee bar with opinions.

sections.heading: The machine and the foam
paragraphs: The De'Longhi Stilosa Espresso Machine in Matte Black: a 15-bar pump machine with a steam wand, about 11 inches tall, small enough for a regular counter. The Martha Stewart 10oz Milk Frother and Steamer in Linen Cream has a glass cup and settings for dense foam, light foam, hot chocolate and cold foam.

sections.heading: The cute part
paragraphs: The Pioneer Woman Ainsley Ceramic Mug Set in Coral, four 16-ounce stoneware mugs with a scalloped rim and cream stripes. The Paris Hilton 3-Piece Ceramic Kitchen Canister Set in Pink, with bamboo lids and gold Sugar, Coffee and Tea script. And the Paris Hilton 13.5 oz Double Wall Glass Coffee Mug with an iridescent finish and That's Hot on the front.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The kitchen, the tile, the cinnamon rolls, the mug tree, the garland and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, color and size before you buy.
